Bolton Food Marketing & Communication Milano, IT Global Marketing & New Business Development Product Manager We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Global Marketing & New Business Development team in our Food Business Unit based in Milan. How you make the difference As Global Marketing & New Business Development Product Manager, your mission will be to help build a new distinctive, desirable and culturally relevant premium seafood brand. You will create meaningful connections with consumers through digital storytelling, social media, inspiring collaborations and memorable brand experiences. You will identify new opportunities for the new brand to become part of the worlds of premium gastronomy, wine, design, hospitality and contemporary lifestyle. We are looking for someone who combines strong brand-building skills with aesthetic sensitivity, curiosity and the energy to turn original ideas into concrete initiatives. How Your Agenda Looks Like Brand Identity & Desirability: Help define and bring to life a distinctive brand positioning, identity and tone of voice. Build awareness, relevance and desirability among premium food consumers, identifying the cultural moments and consumption occasions where the new brand can naturally play a role. Digital & Social Media: Drive the brand digital presence, particularly social platforms, content creation and community engagement. Develop visually distinctive storytelling, explore emerging formats and work with creative partners to make the brand relevant and engaging online. Creators & Influence: Identify and activate relevant food creators, chefs and opinion leaders, designing collaborations that feel authentic to the brand and generate quality engagement, reach and advocacy. Premium Partnerships & Brand Collaborations: Propose, develop and activate distinctive collaborations with premium brands in wine and sparkling wine, design, hospitality and lifestyle. Explore selective product placement, branded content and premium culinary entertainment opportunities, from major events to relevant television and streaming formats. Experiential Marketing & Brand Activation: Create memorable experiences, tastings, chef collaborations and curated events that make the new brand visible in the right places, with the right audiences. Manage partners, budgets and flawless execution. Brand & Business Performance: Contribute to strategic and annual marketing planning; define clear objectives and monitor brand health, social and digital performance, activation outcomes and return on investment. Connect brand-building initiatives with sales and commercial priorities. Cross-Functional & Project Management: Collaborate with Sales, Trade Marketing, R&D, Finance and external agencies. Coordinate selected packaging and innovation initiatives, ensuring consistency with the brand positioning Your Team You will report directly to the Global Marketing & New Business Development Associate Director Food. What Makes You a Great Fit Education: Master’s Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field Work Experience: 3-4 years of experience in Brand or Product Management, Digital Marketing, or similar roles Technical Skills: Hands-on knowledge of digital platforms, social media, creators and content formats, with the ability to develop engaging digital storytelling strategies and interpret performance insights. Strong understanding of brand positioning and visual identity, combined with experience in developing partnerships and managing activations from concept to execution. Soft Skills: Creative and entrepreneurial mindset, with a strong sense of aesthetics, curiosity and a proactive approach. Able to build meaningful relationships, bring fresh ideas to the table and turn them into concrete projects through a strong sense of ownership. Languages: fluent in Italian and proficient in English Digital Literacy: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, together with fluency in digital and social marketing tools. What’s In For You Starting Salary: from € 45.000 (based on experience and skills) Work Location: Milan, Italy Contract Type: Permanent Full Time or Part Time: Full Time Hybrid Working & Flexibility: Yes, flexible smart working policy Benefits: Meal vouchers worth €12 per day, health insurance, Corporate welfare plan; CCNL: Alimentare Curious About Us? Dive In: About Bolton Bolton is an Italian family-owned fast-moving consumer goods company with 10.500 people located across 60 offices, 17 production facilities, 10 R&D laboratories, and 14 fishing vessels worldwide. With a diverse portfolio of over 60 quality brands, Bolton has been enriching the lives of millions of people every day for more than 75 years, making their everyday more delicious, more enjoyable, useful, and beautiful. About Bolton Food Bolton Food and Tri Marine, business unit of Bolton, oversee the entire food supply chain, including managing a fleet of fishing vessels and promoting sustainable fisheries (in collaboration with WWF and OXFAM). The production is conducted through a network of 10 specialized plants globally. We offer a range of well-known brands such as Rio Mare, Saupiquet, Cuca, and Isabel, providing innovative and carefully-prepared food products enjoyed by millions of families worldwide. Il progetto prevede il lancio a Milano a partire dal 2027, con un piano di espansione nazionale e internazionale già definito. Il ruolo combina execution commerciale e visione strategica, in un contesto early-stage ad alto potenziale, con piena esposizione strategica e operativa e collaborazione diretta con il Founder. Ruolo e responsabilità Avrai la responsabilità di costruire e sviluppare il mercato. Segnala offerta di lavoro Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da FAW Willem Bekkema Willem Bekkema Siamo un marchio cinese in rapida crescita nel settore dei veicoli elettrici (EV) e dell’automotive consumer, impegnato nel lancio su larga scala in tutta Europa. In qualità di Sales Development Manager (Italia) sarai la figura chiave a livello locale per lo sviluppo e la crescita della nostra rete di concessionari, delle attività di marketing e dei risultati di vendita sul mercato italiano. Unirai un approccio operativo al supporto commerciale, allo sviluppo della rete dealer, all’esecuzione delle attività di marketing e all’analisi del mercato locale, con l’obiettivo di costruire rapidamente una presenza solida del brand e raggiungere ambiziosi target di vendita in uno dei mercati EV più promettenti d’Europa. Si tratta di un ruolo ad alto impatto e con forte spirito imprenditoriale, ideale per chi si trova a proprio agio in un ambiente dinamico e internazionale e desidera avere un ruolo centrale nell’introdurre in Italia un marchio automobilistico cinese moderno. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute annual marketing and channel development plans for the Italian market, including brand promotion, digital marketing campaigns, channel expansion, and local activation to drive sales targets. Build, develop, and manage the local dealer network : recruit, onboard, and continuously improve dealer sales capabilities; provide training, tools, and support to maximize dealer performance and lead conversion. Manage local media, KOLs, influencers, and strategic partnerships to increase brand awareness, reputation and engagement among Italian consumers and fleet customers. Monitor the effectiveness of market activities, providing data insights and strategic optimization recommendations. Design and optimize channel incentives and marketing support programmes (promotions, bonuses, co-marketing funds) to boost dealer motivation, marketing efficiency, and overall terminal (dealer) performance. Monitor local market trends, consumer insights, competitor activities, sales data, and inventory levels: provide regular analysis and recommendations to adjust marketing, channel, and sales strategies in real time. Oversee dealer inventory, orders and operational processes : resolve product-mix issues, delivery challenges, and day-to-day operational bottlenecks between dealers, headquarters, and logistics. Ensure consistent brand standards across all touch-points: support dealers with showroom design, customer experience standards, campaign execution, service upgrades, and after-sales marketing activities. Required experience & Background 4–8 years of relevant experience in automotive, mobility, consumer goods, or retail channel sales/marketing (automotive/EV experience is a strong advantage). Proven track record in dealer network development, channel management, or sales support in Italy. Experience with B2B/B2C channel sales, dealer training, and performance management. Hands-on digital marketing and campaign execution experience. Required Skills & Competencies Strong commercial acumen and result-oriented mindset. Excellent analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable plans. Outstanding communication and relationship-building skills (dealers, partners, internal stakeholders). High energy, pro-activity, and ability to work independently in a fast-paced, international environment. Cultural agility – comfortable working with a remote/Chinese headquarters team. Required Languages Italian (native or C2 level) – mandatory. English (C1 level minimum) – mandatory. Chinese is a big plus. Required Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, Economics, or related field. Required specifics Your home location should be in the Milan area or within a maximum 2-hour commute (e.g. Monza, Varese, Como, Bergamo, Novara, or similar). As this position is a satellite to our European HQ, you will work in a hybrid model with frequent travel to dealers and touch-points across Italy. What We Offer On-Target Earnings of €70,000 – €85,000 gross per year, consisting of a competitive fixed base salary (including 13th and 14th month) plus a 25% performance-based bonus linked to dealer development and sales targets. Mobility Budget to cover your preferred form of transportation Hybrid working model with the possibility to work from home up to 2 days per week, supported by a monthly home-office allowance ( Rimborso for lavoro agile ) of €300. Private medical insurance coverage. International growth opportunities within a rapidly expanding Chinese EV brand. Direct exposure to senior management and the chance to shape the Italian market entry from the ground up. About FAW Europe / HONGQI FAW Europe is a subsidiary of the China FAW Group Corporation, which is one of the oldest and largest automotive manufacturers in China. Originally founded in 1953 as First Automotive Works, the corporation operates internationally to export and manufacture vehicles in over 70 countries. Ranging from heavy-duty and commercial trucks (through FAW Trucks) to municipal transit buses, construction machinery, and passenger cars. Flagship brands include Jiefang (commercial trucks), Bestune (passenger cars) and HONGQI (high-end luxury vehicles; https://www.hongqi.nl). Through various international subsidiaries, joint ventures and assembly plants, FAW has a massive presence outside of China, particularly across markets in Africa, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, and Latin America. In addition to our own brands, FAW-Volkswagen and FAW Toyota are partnerships that build and sell vehicles within China and globally. A reference and background check will be part of the selection process. WE WILL ONLY BE ACCEPTING APPLICATIONS FROM APPLICANTS CURRENTLY RESIDENT WITHIN THE EUROPEAN UNION, WITH AN UNRESTRICTED RIGHT TO WORK IN ITALY. ACQUISITION AS A RESULT OF THIS VACANCY IS NOT APPRECIATED. title: Digital Marketing & PR Manager
motivazione: Digital & PR Manager per un cliente beauty: strategia digital PR, influencer marketing, agenzie e budget, e hai gestito 400k e agenzie. Gap: chiedono 4-5 anni specifici in Digital PR/influencer in beauty, fashion o lifestyle, e il ruolo è più comunicazione che vendita/marketing integrato. Annuncio pubblicato da un'agenzia per il lavoro (Ali Professional).
testo_completo: Ali Professional Divisione IT & DIGITAL ricerca per importante cliente, azienda del settore Beauty e Cosmetics, un Digital & PR Manager che si occupi di sviluppare e coordinare la strategia digitale e di comunicazione del brand, rafforzandone la visibilità e la reputazione sui canali online e offline. Responsabilità: · Definire e gestire la strategia di Digital PR e comunicazione del brand, in linea con gli obiettivi di business e con il posizionamento dei prodotti. · Pianificare e coordinare attività di influencer marketing, gestendo la selezione dei talent, la negoziazione e il monitoraggio delle collaborazioni. · Gestire i rapporti con stampa, media e partner, curando comunicati, kit stampa, seeding ed eventi. · Supervisionare i canali digitali e social del brand, coordinando agenzie e consulenti esterni. · Monitorare i risultati delle campagne attraverso analisi di KPI e reportistica post-campagna, introducendo azioni correttive quando necessario. · Analizzare trend di settore e comportamenti dei consumatori per individuare nuove opportunità di crescita e innovazione. Requisiti: · 4-5 anni di esperienza in ruoli di Digital PR, influencer marketing o comunicazione digitale, in agenzie o in aziende del settore Beauty, Fashion o Lifestyle. · Ottima conoscenza dei principali canali social e delle dinamiche dell’influencer marketing. · Dimostrata esperienza nella gestione di budget, fornitori e agenzie. · Forti capacità analitiche, organizzative e orientamento ai risultati. · Ottime doti comunicative e relazionali in italiano e in inglese. · Costituisce titolo preferenziale una passione per il mondo beauty e per le sue tendenze. Sede di lavoro su Milano.

title: Agency Sales Account - Mediaset AdManager
motivazione: Agency Sales Account in Mediaset AdManager (digital advertising): pipeline, forecast e CRM sono il tuo lavoro, e il canale agenzie è vendita digitale, non vendita pura. Gap: chiedono 4+ anni di sales in advertising/media e un network consolidato di agenzie media che non hai; ruolo da account, sotto il tuo livello, RAL da 45k. La stessa offerta su LinkedIn dice Cologno Monzese.
testo_completo: All’interno di Publitalia ’80, per il team dedicato alla piattaforma Mediaset AdManager, stiamo cercando un/a Agency Sales Account con esperienza nella gestione e nello sviluppo commerciale del canale agenzie. La risorsa avrà la responsabilità di sviluppare un portafoglio di agenzie di comunicazione e media, consolidando le relazioni esistenti e generando nuove opportunità di business per Mediaset AdManager. Cerchiamo un profilo commerciale con una comprovata esperienza all’interno del canale agenzie preferibilmente agenzie indipendenti, forte capacità di relazione e negoziazione, in grado di comprendere le esigenze delle agenzie e dei loro clienti, trasformarle in opportunità concrete e costruire partnership continuative orientate alla crescita del fatturato. Responsabilità principali · Gestirai e svilupperai un portafoglio di agenzie, con responsabilità diretta sulla crescita del business e sul raggiungimento dei target assegnati. · Gestirai le agenzie inbound, dalla presa in carico e qualificazione della lead fino alla prima attivazione, accompagnandole lungo l’intero percorso commerciale e sviluppando successivamente la relazione con l’obiettivo di favorire rebooking e fidelizzazione. · Identificherai e contatterai in modo proattivo nuove agenzie in target con Mediaset AdManager, sviluppando nuove opportunità commerciali e ampliando progressivamente il network di agenzie attive. · Svilupperai relazioni solide con i principali interlocutori delle agenzie, diventando un punto di riferimento commerciale e lavorando sulla crescita del valore della relazione nel tempo. · Intercetterai brief e opportunità commerciali, supportando le agenzie nella definizione delle soluzioni Mediaset AdManager più adatte alle esigenze dei propri clienti e sviluppando proposte in linea con obiettivi, target, geografie e budget. · Gestirai in modo strutturato pipeline, forecast e CRM, monitorando i principali KPI commerciali, tra cui Agency Activation Rate, Conversion Rate, Rebooking Rate, Average Campaign Value e Revenue per Agency, con l’obiettivo di aumentare progressivamente il valore generato dal portafoglio. Chi cerchiamo · Almeno 4 anni di esperienza in ruoli Sales, preferibilmente maturata nel settore advertising, media o digital, con esperienza concreta nella gestione e nello sviluppo commerciale di agenzie media e di comunicazione. · Solida conoscenza del mercato delle agenzie e delle relative dinamiche commerciali, con familiarità nella gestione di brief, nella comprensione delle esigenze dei clienti e nei principali processi di planning e acquisto media. · Network consolidato nel mondo delle agenzie media e di comunicazione, con relazioni e contatti sviluppati nel corso dell’esperienza professionale, che rappresentino una base utile per avviare e sviluppare un’attività di contatto commerciale strutturata e ampliare progressivamente il portafoglio. · Forte orientamento a revenue, crescita del portafoglio e raggiungimento dei target commerciali, con capacità di gestire in autonomia pipeline, forecast e CRM e di utilizzare KPI e dati di performance per organizzare le priorità, monitorare l’andamento delle opportunità e individuare nuove occasioni di sviluppo. · Capacità di gestire il rapporto con l’agenzia nelle diverse fasi del percorso commerciale, dal primo contatto alla presentazione dell’offerta, fino all’attivazione delle campagne e allo sviluppo successivo della relazione, con attenzione alla fidelizzazione e al rebooking. Cosa offriamo · L’opportunità di lavorare su Mediaset AdManager, un progetto strategico per Publitalia ’80 e in continua evoluzione, contribuendo concretamente alla crescita e allo sviluppo del canale agenzie. · Un ruolo con autonomia nella gestione e nello sviluppo del portafoglio, con la possibilità di valorizzare la propria esperienza commerciale e il proprio network. · La possibilità di lavorare in un contesto digitale, dinamico e orientato all’innovazione, contribuendo allo sviluppo di nuove opportunità commerciali e alla crescita delle relazioni con le agenzie. · Un ambiente collaborativo e orientato ai risultati, in cui poter mettere a valore competenze ed esperienza e contribuire direttamente alla crescita di Mediaset AdManager. Contratto vigente CCNL per i dipendenti da aziende del Terziario della Distribuzione e dei Servizi. Ral: da 45.000 €. L’effettivo livello retributivo associato al ruolo verrà determinato sulla base di criteri quali: l’esperienza professionale, l’effettivo livello di conoscenze tecniche, specialistiche e trasversali, l’anzianità nel ruolo, il grado di autonomia e consistenza del contributo atteso, sulla base delle evidenze che emergeranno in fase di selezione.

title: Consumer Marketing Manager Male Grooming IIG
motivazione: Consumer Marketing Manager Male Grooming per Italia, Israele e Grecia: piano di marketing e go-to-market con budget A&P e ROI, e hai guidato 400k e un go-to-market (Koolstories, Dimhora). Gap: chiedono 5-10 anni in FMCG e conoscenza dei canali retail elettrico e food & drug, più una multinazionale. Il link è quello della lista interna per collaboratori temporanei: cerca lo stesso annuncio sul sito pubblico Philips.
testo_completo: Job Title Consumer Marketing Manager Male Grooming IIG Job Description In this role, you have the opportunity to be the guardian of the Consumer Experience for the Male Grooming Category in IIG (Italy-Israel-Greece) Zone. You are responsible for the development and execution of the Local Marketing Activation and go-to-market Plans reflecting the Region (Western Europe) Marketing Strategy and delivering measurable business impact for the respective category in the Zone. Working closely with Regional and Zone Teams to ensure excellence in execution and category performance. Your role: - Be End-to-End responsible of the Category Growth in the Zone Own and drive the E2E performance of the category within the Zone, ensuring excellence across all marketing, commercial and operational touchpoints. Lead the E2E performance squad, orchestrating cross-functional collaboration (Shopper Activation, Sales Excellence, Media/PR, Commercial teams incl. e-commerce) to ensure seamless execution and business impact. Secure business performance in line with KPIs, continuously optimizing plans to exceed targets (Volume & Value Sell-in and Sell-out, Market Share, Integral Gross Margin (IGM), Ratings & Reviews, Marketing ROI, Consumer NPS, Weighted Distribution, On Shelf Availability and Digital Excellence). - Own & Drive the Marketing Strategy for the respective Category in the Zone Develop a deep understanding of Local Consumers, define the relevant target audience/personas, and identify their profiles, needs, interests and key motivations. Develop and execute the integrated 24-months Local Marketing Activation Plan for IIG countries, based on the agreed Strategic Plan of Record (SPOR), Regional Marketing Activation Plans (RMAPs) and Annual Operating Plan (AOP). Champion the voice of the Zone, delivering consumer, market, competition and trend insights to the Western Europe and Zone teams. Own the 4Ps of Marketing: Product: define and implement the the right portfolio and value proposition (SKU optimization, phase-in/phase-out management) based on the Western Europe range. Work closely with Excellence team to optimize the assortment strategy. Price: shape local pricing positioning and channelization, considering market & competition arena Place: drive the right channel and distribution strategy Promotion: build an integrated communication and activation plan with a Full Funnel approach, localizing global toolkits in collaboration with the Media team and facilitate Shopper navigation in collaboration with the Activation team. Work closely with Excellence team to optimize the promo strategy and ultimately drive preference, increase conversion and basket size. Ensure that every decision, investment and marketing activity is directly linked to the marketing objective, maximizing effectiveness and impact. In collaboration with Trade & Shopper marketing team, initiates and realizes local trade marketing actions and promotions on the basis of the recommendations, in order to stimulate sell-out and loyalty of the distribution channel. - Performance Optimization & Business Growth Lead 6-18 month strategic planning, ensuring alignment with long-term growth plans, while also supporting short-term 0-6 month planning to deliver key yearly business objectives. Drive Marketing Performance Optimization and continuous improvement by applying LEAN principles (Daily Management Board, Problem-Solving methodologies). Take ownership of the controllable A&P budget, securing the best investment mix (Media, Shopper, Sampling) and ensuring maximum ROI and alignment with strategic objectives. - Excellence in Execution – Marketing & Activation Drive best-in-class marketing execution across all consumer touchpoints, ensuring perfect brand visibility in all channels (offline and online). Ensure Product Detail Pages (PDPs), Point-of-Sales (PoS) and in-store activations are aligned with category strategy and executed flawlessly. - Innovation & Future Growth Envision and shape the long-term (5 years) marketing strategy for the respective Category in the Zone scouting future consumer and market trends. Contribute to the development of new business models (like subscriptions, Rental, Try&Buy), working closely with the Western Europe team. Support and lead regional strategic initiatives that drive long-term brand equity and business success. You are part of: The IIG Personal Health Marketing team , where a professional but fun workplace atmosphere is valued and a diverse multi-functional team will greet you. You will report to the Consumer Marketing Leader IIG. You will collaborate with many different teams and stakeholders both at local (Italy, Israel, Greece) and at Western Europe level. You are the right fit if you have: Bachelor degree (preferable in Business Admin. with major in Marketing) 5-10 years working experience in Business Marketing domain, FMCG and/or Personal Care electrical appliances industry and in activating marketing plans in B2C environment Solid knowledge of the Italian Electrical Retail and Food & Drug channels. Category Marketing capabilities (knowledge and confidence with Sales Fundamentals KPIs i.e. Weighted Distribution, Assortment Share, Promo Share, Stock & Sell-out, On Shelf Availability) High analytical skills (with proven track record) with ability to go deeply into the numbers / advanced Excel knowledge AI enthusiast and early adopter Language skills: English (fluent) and Italian (mother tongue) Global agility / International mindset, consumer-centric approach, data-driven decision maker Ability to lead a cooperative effort among members of multifunctional teams Valuable and strong team player Attitude to take ownership and strong orientation to results, negotiation skills Passionate for Health & Beauty / Personal Care matter Compensation & benefits Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is €43.420,00 - €72.366,66. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations. This role is eligible for short-term incentive, with your annual rewards linked to both individual performance and company results. We’ll share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision. Benefits include flexible/hybrid working, paid time-off, health and wellbeing benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives and learning and development opportunities. How we work together We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. About Philips Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business , discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose . If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care .
